text:
alex-park: Hi team, Alex here 1 starting on CS today. Quick blockers: I can't see invoices in HubSpot, Aircall softphone not ringing, and I need the payments/refunds playbook + canned refund scripts. Who do I ping?

marta-cs-lead: welcome Alex! Ping @ben-ops for HubSpot/Aircall seats. Payments playbook is owned by Finance + CS; I'll add you to Notion and Drive.

ben-ops: hey @alex-park 1b1b send the email you used to sign up and I'll spin up seats. We keep MFA/backups in 1Password entries: "redwood-mfa" and "cs-sandbox".

onboard-bot: Access ticket created: TICKET-9991 (HubSpot: CS Agent, Aircall softphone). Assigned to ben-ops. ETA ~2 hours.

alex-park: alex.park@redwood.ai. thanks! I clicked the Notion link but I don't have view on the Payments playbook yet.

ben-ops: HubSpot seat created (role: "CS Agent"). Login: https://redwood.hubspot.com/login. Note: invoice visibility requires "Billing Viewer" role, I'll request that now.

alex-park: still can't view invoices under the customer's timeline, permission denied error.

ben-ops: updated your role to include Billing Viewer. Refresh HubSpot and you should see the Invoices tab. If not, LMK and I'll escalate.

marta-cs-lead: Payments playbook is in Drive > Sales & CS > Playbooks > Payments. I'll mirror the Refunds quick scripts into Notion under CS > Playbooks > Quick Start.

sam-legal: quick policy note: when sharing invoice screenshots externally, redact PII. Internal sharing for support/finance is fine but keep it in the ticket. See policy: https://redwood.ai/policies/data-sharing.

alex-park: HubSpot invoices visible now, thanks. Aircall invite arrived but softphone doesn't ring when calls come in.

ben-ops: assigning you +1 (415) 555-1422. It should push in ~10 minutes. If softphone still silent, check browser mic/audio and App > Preferences > Device.

onboard-bot: TICKET-9991 status updated: ready.

alex-park: Gong invite came through. Marta, where are the refund/chargeback scripts?

marta-cs-lead: Drive path: Drive > Sales & CS > Playbooks > Payments > Refunds. Short canned reply (paste below):

marta-cs-lead: "Hi <Name>, thanks for flagging this. I've initiated a refund for <amount>. You should see the credit on your statement within 5-10 business days. Ticket: <case-id>. If you need faster escalation please reply and I'll loop Finance."

ben-ops: FYI HubSpot ops tip: use property "Invoice Status" and label activity notes with tag "refund_request" so SalesOps can pick them up in their queue.

alex-park: who do I loop for finance escalations or exceptions (same-day refunds)?

marta-cs-lead: loop @finance-ops and me; include invoice #, customer name, and a short reason. I'll intro you to our finance contact on first exception.

alex-park: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll run through the playbook and ping here if anything stalls. :tada:
